girdi.command: ls -R core test 2>/dev/null | head -60 && echo "--- AGENTS ---" && cat AGENTS.md && echo "--- pkg ---" && cat package.json
girdi.description: List repo structure and read AGENTS.md

girdi.command: cat core/hooks/hooks.json && echo "=== dur.js ===" && cat core/hooks/dur.js && echo "=== LINES lib ===" && wc -l core/hooks/lib.js

cd core/hooks && echo "=== defter.short ===" && sed -n '/^function short/,/^}/p' defter.js && echo "=== defter.job/lastText/LEDGER ===" && sed -n '/^function job/,/^}/p;/^function lastText/,/^}/p' defter.js && grep -n "LEDGER =" defter.js && echo "=== count file/sum/handle ===" && sed -n '/^function file/,/^}/p;/^function sum/,/^}/p' count.js && sed -n '/^function handle/,/^}/p' count.js && echo "=== mod.items ===" && sed -n '/^function items/,/^}/p' mod.js && echo "=== kitap ===" && sed -n '/^function transcript/,/^}/p;/^function entries/,/^}/p;/^function turn/,/^}/p;/^function audit/,/^}/p;/^function prompt/,/^}/p' kitap.js

girdi.description: dur.js kancasını örnek Stop girdisiyle çalıştır
